若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。

archiveTitle 对应 period：日报｜、早报｜、晚报｜；英文对应 Daily Brief |、Morning Brief |、Evening Brief |。Daily 窗口为前日10:10 exclusive 至当日10:10 inclusive，plannedAt=当日12:00；10:10—12:00 新事实属于下一期，历史迁移窗口以 packet 为准。

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Build mobile sea fortresses and confront a living ocean.
Once Human’s Isles of Abyss expansion launches on PS5 tomorrow
Hey everyone, we have huge news to share with you today. Once Human’s largest free expansion yet, Isles of Abyss, is officially launching tomorrow, October 22 （October 2 1 ) on PlayStation 5. We’ve taken the strange worlds survival you know and love, and plunged it into uncharted waters. Starting tomorrow, you can leave the safety of dry land behind, set sail across five brand-new oceanic regions, and face down brand new threats unlike anything you’ve ever encountered before.
When we set out to build this expansion, we wanted to make sure that the sea felt like more than just a blue backdrop or a way to get from A to B. In Isles of Abyss, the entire ocean is a massive, conscious entity known as “The Sunken Lord.”
Isles of Abyss introduces a seamless, mutually feeding progression loop between land and sea. Resources gathered from exploring mysterious islands fuel the naval tech and heavy weaponry needed to survive open-water encounters. In turn, venturing into the deep sea unlocks specialized materials that enhance your terrestrial gear and base progression. Beneath the waves, a dedicated underwater exploration layer awaits, where you can dive deep into sunken ruins for lost treasure, harvest rare aquatic resources, and engage in deep-sea hunting to sustain your crew and gain special materials.
The tide has turned, and the living ocean is waiting. Grab your friends, head over to the PlayStation Store, and download Once Human to be ready for the free-to-play Isles of Abyss expansion arriving on PS5 tomorrow..

packages.headline: PlayStation Indies: 9 must-play horror games for the spooky season

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Pick your Halloween thrill, be it narrative-driven terrors, multiplayer frights or twisted adventures.
PlayStation Indies: 9 must-play horror games for the spooky season
There is joy in being a little scared. From pleasantly spooky atmospheres to frights that make your fingers fidget on the controller. Our team has played many horror-themed indie games, from cozy to creepy, and we’re excited to share some of our favorites to keep players frightened and having fun this Halloween season.
What’s scary about slot machines? Not much, unless you’ve ever tried to navigate a casino floor with your wallet (and ears) intact. But what if your life was riding on every jackpot? What if you were locked in a grim, rusted-metal nightmare room, suspended above a bottomless pit, with only a broken toilet and a few lucky charms to keep you company? Bet you’d be pretty scared then, huh? Huh!?
In any case, that’s the premise of CloverPit , a macabre slot-machine roguelite in which your only hope of survival is to win enough coins to clear an ever-rising debt. This isn’t entirely random; unlocking a few of those charms can tilt the odds in your favor, and learning to synergize them can keep you a few steps ahead of your unseen captors.
Also, the longer you survive, the more likely you are to get bonuses you can build strategies around, giving you more breathing room to plan an escape. So don’t get discouraged if your first few attempts send you tumbling into the abyss – there’s always a chance for better luck, even unstoppable luck, on your next run.
Escape the Backrooms is a horror exploration game that plunges you into the unsettling world of the internet’s infamous Backrooms legend. Traverse more than 30 eerie levels, solve puzzles, avoid terrifying entities, and search for a way out. Just remember: survival is far from guaranteed.
Brave the Backrooms alone for a tense, atmospheric experience, or team up online with up to three friends. Proximity voice chat means you’ll need to stick together whilst communicating carefully! The catch? Keep your voices to a whisper; the entities can hear you too. What makes Escape the Backrooms a must-play is how brilliantly it balances psychological horror with chaotic multiplayer fun. Its unsettling environments and unpredictable dangers make solo exploration genuinely nerve-racking, while playing with friends can quickly turn into a chorus of panicked shouting and questionable decisions. Few horror games make being lost so terrifying, or watching your friends make everything worse so entertaining. – Jonty Binns, Global Account Manager

packages.headline: Stranger Than Heaven hands-on report: brutal combat and the glitz of show business intermix

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
RGG Studio’s upcoming PS5 title charts 50 years in the life of Makoto Daito.
Stranger Than Heaven hands-on report: brutal combat and the glitz of show business intermix
Fists clashing, bones crunching—it’s combat at its most visceral. On the flip side, there is the glitz and glamour of show business, where you handle everything from song composition to live stage productions. Stranger Than Heaven , an all-new title from RGG Studio, the team behind the Like a Dragon series, delivers a remarkably diverse array of gameplay as it follows the 50-year journey of protagonist Makoto Daito.
At the Kokura steel mill, we tackled a long battle against multiple foes to rescue a kidnapped Tae. Stranger Than Heaven features a unique combat system that uses the shoulder buttons and triggers to control the left and right sides of Daito’s body independently. You fight by alternating left and right attacks while guarding in the direction of incoming strikes. Because your inputs sync directly with the character’s movements, the controls feel remarkably tactile. From the wide wind-up of a punch to the impact upon landing a blow, the combat carries the heavy, raw weight of human bodies clashing.
When producing a performance, you select singers, musicians, and stage effects like confetti or fog machines. Every show comes with target revenue goals, requiring you to carefully balance performer skills against operational costs. Once the curtain rises, Daito personally operates the lighting and special effects. Successfully executing the on-screen button prompts enhances the stage effects and increases the show’s revenue. Rather than relying heavily on player twitch reflexes like a traditional rhythm game, success seems to hinge far more on pre-show planning, such as choosing the right song, cast, and stage setup. Even from our brief trial, the sheer variety of music and strategic depth make this feature look exceptionally promising.
Stranger Than Heaven launches on PlayStation 5 on Friday, January 15, 2027.
At a recent press preview event, we got hands-on time with select portions from four distinct chapters: the Prologue, Kokura in Fukuoka, Kure in Hiroshima, and Minami in Osaka.

packages.headline: Thirty Years of Lara Croft

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
As Tomb Raider turns thirty, we look back at the adventurer who changed gaming with Meagan Marie, Director of Brand Creative at Crystal Dynamics and a lifelong fan who helps steward the character.
Few people are better positioned to reflect on three decades of Lara Croft than Meagan Marie. A longtime member of the Tomb Raider team at Crystal Dynamics, author of 20 Years of Tomb Raider , and a fan who has cosplayed the character more than a dozen times, she has spent her career at the intersection of Lara’s past and her future. With Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis on the horizon, the anniversary is a chance to look at how one adventurer has been carried forward across thirty years.
It began in 1996 with Core Design, a small studio in Derby, England. A tiny team of six primary developers, with additional art and audio support, built the original Tomb Raider and, in the process, created one of gaming’s most enduring icons. “They changed the face of the industry, and they changed the face of what we expect from our protagonists,” Marie says. “They are responsible for creating the franchise that we all love thirty years later.”
Lara was the vision of designer Toby Gard, conceived as a heroine defined by intelligence and athleticism, and her impact reached far beyond the screen almost immediately. By the late nineties she was appearing in magazines dressed by Alexander McQueen and Gucci, effectively the first virtual model. “Lara Croft has always been a curious and complex figure,” Marie says. “She’s an academic who values reason yet is willing to accept the seemingly impossible. She’s effortlessly cool and witty but will geek out when unearthing history. Lara contains multitudes.” That combination, created by Core Design, is the foundation that everything since has been built on.
For nearly two decades, Crystal Dynamics has carried that legacy forward. Taking over the franchise, the studio faced a defining challenge: how to move Lara into each new era without losing what made her Lara. “There’s that foundation of what makes Lara, Lara,” Marie says. “It’s the passion for uncovering the unknown, the sense of wonder and discovery, her physical prowess, even her quippiness. That foundation of who Lara is has always been there. It’s about pushing and pulling the different levers in the different situations and the different stages of her life.”
That stewardship took shape first across the Legend , Anniversary , and Underworld trilogy, which modernized Lara’s movement and storytelling while protecting her core. Then, in 2013, Crystal Dynamics did something bolder: it rebooted the character entirely with the Survivor trilogy. For Marie, that reinvention is personal. She wrote the cover story that first revealed it to the world. “I was working at Game Informer magazine and I wrote the cover story on the Survivor Series. I was the first journalist in the world to be introduced to it,” she says. “I just saw the vision and I fell in love with it.”
What won her over was watching Lara become the hero players already knew. “You get to see her doubt herself, push through her own fear to find true bravery,” Marie says. “You can see the building blocks falling into place.” The reboot also brought in a whole new audience. “We now have fans that tell us they grew up playing the reboot games as children, that the 2013 game was their first introduction to the franchise,” she says. “It’s a huge honor to add to that legacy.”
Now Crystal Dynamics returns to where it all began. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is the studio’s reimagining of the 1996 original, developed in collaboration with Flying Wild Hog, built to represent every version of the iconic Lara Croft at once. “It’s a culmination of everybody’s passion and thirty years of history,” Marie says, “a chance for longtime fans to relive the story and for newer players to finally see where the legend began.”

Rockstar Gamesは11月19日に、『 グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA 6） 』を発売予定。対応プラットフォームはPS5/XBOX Series X|Sだ。同作の発売日に“プレイするために仕事を休む従業員”が多くいることで、大規模な経済損失が発生するのではないかとの説がまことしやかに報じられている。
『GTA 6』は、Rockstar Gamesが手がける人気オープンワールドクライムアクションゲーム『グランド・セフト・オート』シリーズの最新作だ。本作の舞台となるのは、米国の架空の州であるレオナイダ州。過去作『グランド・セフト・オート：バイスシティ』などに登場した都市・バイスシティを擁する州だ。主人公となるのは、ジェイソンとルシア。シリーズ最大級に進化した規模と没入感が表現されるという。
当初のCadena SERの報道は2025年7月、つまり『GTA 6』の発売予定日が延期前の2026年5月26日であったころに掲載されたものであり、先述したMontalvo氏など複数の学者の証言がまとめられている。同氏は『GTA 6』発売に伴う欠勤についての見解を述べており、仕事を休んでゲームをプレイする層は、主に18歳～30歳の若い男性になるとの見立てを示している。もっとも影響を受けるのはテクノロジー業界であり、そうした業界ではリモートワークの場合が多く、労働者に対する管理が比較的難しいからだという。そのため「仕事を抜け出して新作ゲームを遊ぶことが（ほかの業界と比べて）はるかに簡単」との見方を述べている。また同氏は2000年代半ば以降の若い男性の余暇時間の増加において、ゲームなどの娯楽が増加分の約半分に寄与したとされ、労働時間を約1.5％～3％減少させた可能性があるとする研究にも言及した（ National Bureau of Economic Research ）。
このほかCadena SERの報道では『GTA』シリーズの若年層における知名度の高さや、ゲームが単なる娯楽ではなく文化に及ぼす影響力が大きい点などについて、有識者の見解が伝えられた。さまざまな観点から、『GTA 6』発売日に休暇をとる、あるいは仕事をさぼったりする従業員が多く発生する可能性を論じているわけだろう。そして具体的な根拠は不明ながら、同メディアは米国では『GTA 6』の発売初日だけ10億ドル（約1600億円・現在のレート）の損失が発生するとの予測を伝えていた。
先述したとおりCadena SERの記事は2025年7月に掲載されたものであるが、今年11月19日の『GTA 6』の発売が近づくにつれて、複数のメディアが引用するかたちでふたたび注目を集めている。ところが当初のCadena SERの記事になかった“尾ひれ”もついており、10億ドルの損失予測がMontalvo氏の発言となっていたり、『GTA 6』発売当日に「米国で150万人が一斉に欠勤する」「米国の生産性が2％低下する」といった出所不明の情報がそれぞれ同氏の発言かのように付け加えられている。業界屈指の注目作である『GTA 6』の発売を前に、真偽不明の情報までが入り混じり、壮大な噂が広まる状況となっている。
なお、具体的な人数や影響はともかく『GTA 6』の発売日に休暇を予定しているゲーマーは少なからずいることだろう。たとえば The Wall Street Journal は、11月19日周辺で休暇を予定しているというゲーマーの証言をまとめた記事を掲載。ソフトウェアエンジニアや公務員といった幅広い職種の人々から証言が寄せられている。中でも「ジョージア州フォート・スチュワート陸軍基地」のある大隊では、8月1日から11月14日までに再入隊した兵士は『GTA 6』の発売日にあわせて4日間の外出許可が与えられるインセンティブプログラムが実施されているという。同誌が広報担当のAngel Tomko中佐に取材したところによると、この施策は新任のキャリアカウンセラーの提案によるもので、対象となる130人の兵士のうち取材時点で44人がこの制度に申し込んでいたそうだ。
そんな本作の発売日に「仕事を休む人が大量に発生し、多額の経済損失が発生するのではないか」との説が唱えられている。もともとはスペインのメディア Cadena SER が2025年7月に、ポンペウ・ファブラ大学で経済学教授を務めるJosé García Montalvo氏などへの取材に基づき報道。この証言を一部引用するかたちで International Business Times などが改めて同氏の見解を報じている。

packages.headline: BioWare Shutting Down, Next Mass Effect Canceled

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
BioWare is shutting down and the next Mass Effect game is canceled, according to a new report.
BioWare Shutting Down, Next Mass Effect Canceled
Mass layoffs at EA hit 400 staff.
BioWare is shutting down and the next Mass Effect game is canceled, EA has announced.
Bloomberg said BioWare closes its doors amid mass layoffs at Electronic Arts, which amount to 400 people losing their jobs (approx. 3% of total staff). Roughly 50 of these roles were at BioWare.
After the franchise-best sales of Dragon Age: Inquisition, BioWare sought live-service success with Anthem, then spent the best part of a decade on the troubled Dragon Age: The Veilguard. Both underperformed. Mass Effect, meanwhile, has seen mixed success. Mass Effect Andromeda is widely considered a disappointment among fans, though the series' more recent Legendary Edition remaster was well-received.
BioWare had spent the past half a decade teasing the next Mass Effect's setting and story. We'd had it confirmed that Mass Effect 5 would have been set hundreds of years after Mass Effect 3 , and feature a narrative that re-centers the action on the franchise's original Milky Way setting, long after the Reapers were defeated. Now, fans will never find out what happens next.
IGN understands that as of now, the Prime Video live-action Mass Effect show remains in development at Amazon MGM Studios . Earlier this year, Mass Effect TV series co-showrunner Daniel Casey refuted a report that suggested the upcoming adaptation had recently undergone rewrites to be "more appealing to non-gamers."
Last year's Battlefield 6 was a "great success," they said. Future Battlefield games are on the way, as well as the Respawn and DICE collaboration project that is reportedly Star Wars: Battlefront 3. EA said it will also continue to "invest heavily" in Respawn's battle royale, Apex Legends, over the next few years by introducing brand new gameplay modes in multiplayer, and "other new experiences, to expand the universe."

packages.headline: EAが「BioWareを閉鎖」し、『Mass Effect』最新作も開発中止。歴史あるRPGスタジオに、突然の幕切れ

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
BioWareが手がけていた『Mass Effect』シリーズの最新作が開発中止され、同スタジオが閉鎖されることが明かされた。
EAが「BioWareを閉鎖」し、『Mass Effect』最新作も開発中止。歴史あるRPGスタジオに、突然の幕切れ
Electronic Arts（EA）は10月22日、今後の事業方針について発表。このなかでBioWareが手がけていた『Mass Effect』シリーズの最新作を開発中止し、同スタジオを閉鎖すると明かした。
BioWareは1995年に設立され、2007年にEAに買収されたカナダのスタジオだ。SFRPG『Mass Effect』シリーズやファンタジーRPG『Dragon Age』シリーズなどを手がけてきた。直近で同社は2024年11月に『Dragon Age』シリーズの最新作『ドラゴンエイジ: ヴェイルの守護者』をリリース。2020年に発表された『Mass Effect』新作を開発中であった。
一方で、BioWareについては小規模チームで『Mass Effect』シリーズ最新作の初期開発に取り組んでいたものの、開発中止が決定。同スタジオおよびエドモントンの事務所が閉鎖されるという。なおEAは、BioWareはRPGジャンルの形成に貢献した伝説的なスタジオであるとして、この決定を軽々しく下したわけではないと伝えている。
BioWareについては、2025年1月に多数のスタッフをEAの別チームに異動させる方針を明らかにしていた（ 関連記事 ）。『Mass Effect』最新作の開発にはまだスタジオ全体の人員を要する段階ではないことから、ベテラン開発者を中心とした小規模チームで『Mass Effect』最新作を開発していると明かされていた。しかし今回の発表を見るに、同作の開発中止と共にスタジオが閉鎖に至ったわけだ。
今回EAは今後の事業方針について 発表 。DICEなどBattlefield Studiosが手がける『Battlefield 6』が大きな成功を収めているほか、Respawn Entertainmentが手がける『Apex Legends』についても、今後数年間にわたる多額の投資を継続して、まったく新しいマルチプレイゲームモードなどを導入していくという。またDICEとRespawn Entertainmentの力を結集して、将来のプロジェクトを協力して開発していくと伝えている。このほか、開発中の『Marvel’s Iron Man』と、『STAR WARS ジェダイ』シリーズ次回作の発売に向けた取り組みを継続していくことなども伝えられた。

packages.headline: 国産大型メトロイドヴァニア『Chronoscript』、体験版「85%好評」だけど延期した理由。開発者を動かしたユーザーの“質の高いフィードバック”と『Hollow Knight』『Constance』開発者の助言

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
集英社ゲームズのプロデューサー山本正美氏、デスクワークスのディレクター藤井トム氏、メインアーティストの南場ナム氏にインタビューを実施。
国産大型メトロイドヴァニア『Chronoscript』、体験版「85%好評」だけど延期した理由。開発者を動かしたユーザーの“質の高いフィードバック”と『Hollow Knight』『Constance』開発者の助言
集英社ゲームズは9月9日、『Chronoscript: The Endless End』のリリースを延期すると発表した。発売時期は2027年初夏予定。対応プラットフォームはPC（ Steam ）/PS5に加えて、XBOX Series X|S、XBOX on PCでの発売もアナウンスされた。
『Chronoscript: The Endless End』（以下、Chronoscript）は、2D探索型アクションアドベンチャーゲームだ。プレイヤーはひとりの編集者として、とある執筆家から編集依頼を受けて山奥の洋館を訪れる。しかし、一匹の蚊に刺され、血を吸われた途端に気を失ってしまった編集者は、原稿の中で目を覚ますことになる。そして、洋館の主の執筆家である1000年生きる吸血鬼によって書かれた、“終わりの続きの物語”を解き明かしていく。
本作は2Dベースのメトロイドヴァニアながら、全体マップとなる洋館は3Dを用いており、2Dの迷宮と3Dの洋館でゲームが展開していく。2Dベースのマップは手描き調で描かれており、開発はデスクワークスが担当。『Chronoscript』は、同社が手掛けた『RPGタイム！～ライトの伝説～』で見られる手描き調のアートが活かされた作品となっている。
藤井トム（以下、藤井）氏： 『Chronoscript』はジャンルとしては探索型アクションアドベンチャーとして開発しているゲームです。ベースとしては2D横スクロールアクションゲームで、広いマップを探索して、ボスに立ち向かったり、新たな能力を獲得してさらに新たなエリアを開拓していったりと、いわゆるメトロイドヴァニアと言えばユーザーの皆さんにはわかりやすいかもしれません。
山本氏： ゲーム開発でよく言われることですが、開発者は触り心地や難易度に次第に慣れていってしまうんです。アクション性や攻防の感覚といった点にも慣れてしまい、その状態で難易度のバランスを取って「クリアできるし、気持ち良い」と判断して完成させてしまうことがあるんです。『Chronoscript』もそうなりかけていましたが、体験版を通して、もう少し手を入れなければいけないと気づかされました。
――「難しい」にもいろいろな意味がありますが、『Chronoscript』はどういう難しさですか。
藤井氏： 開発初期には、競合タイトル1本1本にスキルがいくつあるのかを数えました。リリース時点とアップデート後でいくつ増えたのかということまで割り出して、そのデータを元に、『Chronoscript』にはどれくらいスキルがあればいいのかを検討しました。

sources.evidenceText:
Zemore Indie Gamesは10月20日、『Pooper Scooper』を発表した。
高難易度・物理演算ネコウンチ運び『Pooper Scooper』発表。 “ウンチの個性”を見極め慎重にゴミ箱へ、この世界のネコは浮いて回る
デベロッパーのZemore Indie Gamesは10月20日、『 Pooper Scooper 』を発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、2026年第4四半期に配信予定だ。
『Pooper Scooper』は、猫のウンチを片付けるシミュレーションゲームだ。舞台となるのは、ベッドやクローゼットが置かれた、ごくありふれた部屋。この部屋ではプレイヤーと飼い猫たちが暮らしているが、恐ろしいことに、猫たちのウンチは“核爆弾級”。一日にとんでもない量のウンチをする、なんとも手のかかる猫たちなのだ。そんな猫たちに邪魔されながら、ウンチをゴミ箱に片付けていく。
『Pooper Scooper』はPC（ Steam ）向けに2026年第4四半期配信予定だ。
本作では、スコップを駆使して猫用トイレに残されたウンチを拾い、ゴミ箱へと運んでいく。プレイヤーは前後左右に移動できるほか、スコップの傾きや向き、高さも細かく調整できる。ウンチを床に落とさず、ゴミ箱に捨てることができればステージクリアだ。ただし、本作では物理演算が働くため、操作を間違えるとウンチが床に散乱してしまう。加えて、ウンチはそれぞれ形や大きさが異なり、スコップのコントロールにも影響するという。一度に運ぶ量が多いほどバランスを保ちづらくなるため、リスクを冒して大量に運ぶか、それとも安全をとって少量ずつ運ぶかの選択を迫られるようだ。

Lucasfilm Gamesのバイスプレジデントを務めるDouglas Reilly氏は10月15日、「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズのゲーム展開について、常にAAAタイトルである必要はないとする見解を語った。
「スター・ウォーズのゲームはAAAじゃなくてもいい」と、権利元幹部が力説。新作ゲーム連続成功で見える“大作頼みじゃない”勝機
Lucasfilm Gamesのバイスプレジデントを務めるDouglas Reilly氏は10月15日、「スター・ウォーズ（STAR WARS）」シリーズのゲーム展開について、常にAAAタイトルである必要はないとする見解を語った。海外メディア The Game Business が伝えている。
Lucasfilmは「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズを展開する映画制作会社だ。同シリーズのゲーム化として、今年8月にターン制ストラテジー『STAR WARS ゼロ・カンパニー』が、今月にはレースゲーム『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』が発売された。両タイトルはともに高い評価を得ており、レビュー集積サイトMetacriticのメタスコアでは『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』は88点、『STAR WARS ゼロ・カンパニー』は発売当初86点を記録（本稿執筆時点では84点）。近年の「スター・ウォーズ」ゲームのなかでも一二を争う水準だ。
開発元としては、『STAR WARS ゼロ・カンパニー』は『XCOM』を手がけたFiraxis Gamesの元開発者たちが設立したBit Reactorが担当。そして『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』は『Burnout』『Need for Speed』『Star Wars: バトルフロント』などのシリーズの主要開発メンバーたちが集まった新興スタジオFuse Gamesが担当した。いずれの作品も、各スタジオのデビュー作である。
Reilly氏によれば、独立系スタジオによって「スター・ウォーズ」のゲームが制作されるこうした状況は、まさに戦略の一部であるそうだ。同氏は、『STAR WARS バトルフロント』のような大規模なAAAタイトルも欠かせないとしつつ、異なるジャンルでストーリーを語る機会がさまざま存在するというのが「スターウォーズ」の素晴らしいところだと説明。同シリーズの世界観でそうした体験を実現してくれる最高のパートナーを見つけることを目標としてきたという。常にAAAタイトルである必要はなく、ときどきAAタイトルでもいいと考えているそうだ。
なお前述された“最高のパートナー”について、Reilly氏は必ずしもトップ5に入るような大手パブリッシャーである必要はないと述べている。実際パブリッシャーについて見ても、『STAR WARS ゼロ・カンパニー』では大手Electronic Artsがパブリッシャーとなっている一方、『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』のパブリッシングを担当したのは、Sumo Groupから2021年に独立を果たしたSecret Modeだ。同氏は選定にあたって、高い品質基準といったいくつかのハードルはあり、実績のないチームよりは経験豊富なところと協業することが多いとしつつも、大小を問わずあらゆる可能性を模索しているとしている。Lucasfilmがゲームのパブリッシャーやデベロッパーを決める上では、スタジオの規模はそれほど重要ではないのかもしれない。
「スター・ウォーズ」のゲーム作品が相次いで成功したことを受けて、今後はより一層、AAAタイトルに限らないさまざまな作品が展開されていくのかもしれない。なお「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズのゲーム作品としては、アクションRPG『Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic』が昨年12月に発表。同作はArcanaut Studiosが開発を手がけており、かつてBioWareで『Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic』の指揮を執ったCasey Hudson氏がディレクターを務めるという。ほかにも、Quantic Dreamによる『Star Wars Eclipse』や、Respawn Entertainmentの『Star Wars ジェダイ』シリーズ第3作の開発が進行中であり、幅広い規模やジャンルで展開がおこなわれていくのだろう。

packages.headline: BioWare Was the Greatest RPG Developer Ever

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
There are many great role-playing game developers, past and present. But none can touch what BioWare has done over 30-plus years.
BioWare Was the Greatest RPG Developer Ever
BioWare is dead , and my feelings are a strange cocktail of anger, sadness, and Jack’s Complete Lack of Surprise. The legendary RPG studio was bought by a private investment group earlier this year, and history shows that venture capital frequently kills what it touches, extracting whatever value out of it that it can before moving onto the next victim. It’s a hell of a contrast to the beginning of BioWare, which started out as such a pure thing. Two practicing doctors, Ray Muzyka and Greg Zeschuk, quit medicine to pursue their dream of making computer role-playing games. Sure, the studio was bought and sold a couple of times between then and now, and yes, BioWare’s recent results haven’t lived up to its venerable past, but my goodness, what a legacy this studio leaves behind.
Everyone knows Baldur’s Gate now on account of Larian Studios’ Game of the Year-winning, 10 out of 10 Baldur’s Gate 3 from 2023, but what younger gamers might not know is that the first two Baldur’s Gate RPGs were built by BioWare in the late ‘90s. While they weren’t the studio’s first games – that honor goes to the 1996 mech action-sim Shattered Steel – they were the two that put BioWare on the map. Each was an incredibly deep and sprawling RPG based on the Dungeons & Dragons ruleset that was good for upwards of 200 hours of gameplay. At the time, they reset the bar for what a CRPG could be. Let me put it this way: Baldur’s Gate 1 took home IGN’s Game of the Year award in 1998 … over Half-Life . That’s how good Baldur’s Gate was.
After another action-game pitstop in the form of 2000’s excellent MDK2, BioWare returned to role-playing with Neverwinter Nights, another CRPG that arguably brought video games closer to the pen-and-paper, pizza-party-at-your-best-friend/DM’s-house version of D&D than any game before it. It was the runner-up for IGN’s Best Role-Playing Game of 2002, finishing behind just one game: a little project you might have heard of called The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind.
Up to this point, BioWare had primarily been known in PC circles as a prominent CRPG developer. And then Microsoft made a deal with the studio and LucasArts to develop an exclusive new Star Wars RPG for the fledgling Xbox console. You already know what the result was: the absolutely unimpeachable Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, which happens to be my personal favorite role-playing game of all time. My biases aside, it is unquestionably one of the best RPGs ever made. It’s also a lock for top-3 Star Wars games of all-time, and it has a strong case for No. 1 on that list. It told an incredible story in Star Wars’s ancient past and truly let you embrace the Light Side or Dark Side of the Force. I went fully evil just because KOTOR let me do so! And not only that, it embraced those choices. At one point, I distinctly remember triple-crossing someone – double-crossing the guy that I’d already double-crossed. Its plot twist is legendary, and on the off chance that the long-in-development-hell remake ever comes out, I won’t spoil it for you here. But whether it was visiting plenty of planets (including Kashyyk!), bonding with your party members (shout-out to my favorite droid, HK-47!), or planning out my evil Force attacks by stacking up my attacks in the turn-based combat system, KOTOR was the ultimate pairing of a beloved IP and an industry-leading developer.
Another Xbox console exclusive followed, albeit from a different team within BioWare. While KOTOR director Casey Hudson was planning something even bigger for his team’s next project, another crew at BioWare delivered the sublime and historically underrated Jade Empire, which was steeped in Chinese mythology. Diablo Is Getting a New Board Game Adaptation You Can Play Solo or With Friends
Announced today, Glass Cannon Unplugged , the same studio behind tabletop adaptations of Don’t Starve, Dying Light, and Apex Legends among others, are getting ready to take on the demons of Sanctuary with Diablo: Unbound. Launching a campaign over on Gamefound , Diablo: Unbound is a cooperative dungeon battler for between 1-4 players and features iconic locations and beasts as you level up, and gear out a champion from familiar classes like the Rogue and Barbarian in a quest to take down the dungeon boss.
Diablo®: Unbound is a co-op dungeon battler for 1–4 players. Choose your Class, Dungeon, enemies, and Boss. Fight hordes, hunt loot, and grow stronger! Follow on Gamefound to claim your free, Gamefound Exclusive Treasure Goblin Expansion Launching Q1 2027. #boardgames #diablo https://t.co/jZbqbVd4ze
At a quick glance, fans of boss battlers and dungeon crawling board games , Diablo: Unbound should take notice as this is already teasing some neat systems. For those attending the massive board game convention in Germany, Spiel Essen, this week, you can try out an early build of the game at the Glass Cannon Unplugged booth in Hall I with the campaign planned to launch in Q1 of 2027.
Details are still fairly scarce but already just in the trailer we get some exciting looks at the game from some awesome looking miniatures, various player boards, and even an idea of what the character systems might be. Judging by the map, Unbound looks to have you and your allies facing off against hordes of monsters on a hex grid.
As a big fan of deck builders , seeing that your special abilities and actions are tied to a deck of sorts, has me intrigued. The trailer also showcases a glimpse at the player boards with spots allocated for various armor pieces (with spots open even for gems) including chest, a left and right weapon slot, helm, ring, and necklace. Skills also appear to be taking a page out of the Slay the Spire board game rulebook with skill cards being double-sided with a base side and upgraded side so prepare for sleeving cards, folks.

"Dragon Ball Xenoverse is a series that we build together with the players through launch, and throughout its post launch life as well," he continued. packages.headline: EA Confirms DICE and Respawn Are Collaborating on a New Project Amidst Star Wars: Battlefront 3 Rumors

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
EA has confirmed that DICE and Respawn are working on a new project together, adding more fuel to rumors about Star Wars: Battlefront 3.
EA Confirms DICE and Respawn Are Collaborating on a New Project Amidst Star Wars: Battlefront 3 Rumors
EA has confirmed that DICE and Respawn are working on a new project together, adding more fuel to rumors about Star Wars: Battlefront 3 .
As part of a larger letter about the future of EA, the publisher confirmed that it is working on new Battlefield games. It also noted that in addition to Battlefield, DICE and Respawn are working together on a "future project" that they hope will unlock growth in their shooter portfolio. This follows rumors from earlier this week that the two companies are working together to make Star Wars: Battlefront 3.
"In addition to our future Battlefield titles, we’ll be bringing together our Respawn and DICE studios to collaborate on a future project that will help us achieve that ambition," said EA. "We can’t wait to share more when the time comes."
Variety also corroborated the Battlefront 3 rumors via sources, though nothing was shared on what the game will look like or when it might release. Other rumors recently suggested that Bungie was in the mix to work on Battlefront 3 or perhaps another project in the Star Wars universe, though nothing has been confirmed on that front. Star Wars: Battlefront 3 has been one of the most demanded titles over the last decade.
DICE's second crack at the Star Wars shooter franchise was controversial at launch due to issues with its monetization strategy , but the game itself was praised up and down by fans. It has remained a respected title among Star Wars lovers, and they've frequently rallied together to demand a sequel . Now, it seems like it will happen, though this time with the assistance of Respawn.
The Titanfall and Apex Legends studio has its own experience working on Star Wars through the Jedi games and the recently-released Star Wars Zero Company. Respawn also worked on a canceled Star Wars shooter, rumored to be a Mandalorian game, leaving fans to wonder what could've been. Only time will tell what this new Respawn and DICE game really is, but if it's Battlefront 3, it has serious potential to be something special.
This news came alongside some doom and gloom. EA confirmed that it was canceling the next Mass Effect and shutting down veteran RPG studio BioWare . The news comes after about a decade of commercial and critical misfires from the studio with games like Mass Effect: Andromeda, Anthem, and Dragon Age: The Veilguard.

packages.headline: EA Halts Development on Mobile Multiplayer Sims Game in Favor of Rumored Sims 4 Sequel

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
EA has paused development on a mobile multiplayer Sims game in favor of moving forward with a rumored Sims 4 sequel.
EA Halts Development on Mobile Multiplayer Sims Game in Favor of Rumored Sims 4 Sequel
EA announced a wide variety of changes and projects today, including the closure of BioWare and the cancelation of Mass Effect 5 . It also seemed to lean into recent rumors that DICE and Respawn are making a new Star Wars Battlefront game . One other big change is that EA is shelving a mobile-first multiplayer Sims project, formerly known as Project Rene and now known as Project Lotus. The game was once envisioned as the next big Sims title , but plans changed to more of a mobile spin-off once EA saw that people were still hanging on to The Sims 4.
With that game being put on the back burner, EA is shifting its focus to a Sims title that it's calling Project Evergreen. Although EA hasn't revealed what the focus of this game will be, rumors have been swirling about this project for a some time now. The game, which was rumored to be under the codename Project X, is expected to be a sequel to The Sims 4. Now, here's where it may get a bit confusing: It's not The Sims 5. It's being viewed more like The Sims 4 2.0. I know, it is unnecessarily complicated.
As covered by Sims Community , the project is reportedly targeting September 2027 as its deadline to go gold, suggesting the game would launch in fall 2027. The game will release on PC and is also expected to be optimized for portable handhelds, such as the Steam Deck. If it really is releasing next year, we will likely hear more about it at The Game Awards or sometime in the first half of 2027.
Earlier this year, the team behind The Sims hinted at a new single-player game in the franchise for PC and console, noting that half of its development team was working on The Sims 4 and its "next evolution."
Ultimately, this sounds like a win for fans who have been hoping for a new traditional entry in the franchise. The Sims 4 was released in 2014, meaning it has been 12 years since the franchise got a new game. There are a ton of updates and expansions that keep the game fresh, but building something from scratch and moving away from all the bloat could be a strong move for the future of the series.

packages.headline: EA Sports Confirms It's Developing an Open-World Football Game

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
EA Sports is working on a new open-world football game, seemingly separate from Madden and College Football.
EA Sports Confirms It's Developing an Open-World Football Game
In a new letter about EA's future , the company outlined what's on the horizon for its different portfolios. For its sports games, the publisher reaffirmed that it is working on a brand new Fight Night game , which will be EA's first boxing game in well over a decade. However, the more interesting announcement is that EA is working on a new open-world football game that it calls "Project Gridiron."
"We have two new projects in development you’ll hear about over the next few months, including a brand-new, social-first open-world experience for our American Football team that we call 'Project Gridiron,'" said EA. "And we are also in pre-production to bring back a beloved, fan-favorite in Fight Night, leveraging capabilities from our simulation fighting team."
It's unclear if Project Gridiron will have some kind of narrative or if its open-world will be a shared online universe, not unlike NBA 2K. Could this be a more mature and gritty football game, similar to what Fight Night Champion did for that series? It's hard to say right now. Madden briefly dabbled with narrative-driven campaigns in the mid to late 2010s with decent results, but eventually turned its focus back toward a broader career mode for those looking for a progressive single-player experience.
While a new College Football is expected to release next year per previous statements from EA Sports , the existence of Project Gridiron creates a question over whether or not Madden will be benched in favor of this new game.
After all, does anyone have the time, money, or interest in three EA-developed football games in a single year? It's also possible this is a total transformation of the Madden experience, but it sounds like something brand new. It sounds like we won't have to wait too long, as EA noted we will learn more about the game in the "next few months." Perhaps we'll hear about this during The Game Awards or sometime in early 2027, but we'll just have to wait and see.

packages.headline: Former BioWare Executive Producer Mark Darrah Says EA Might Be 'More Likely' to Sell IPs Like Mass Effect and Dragon Age After Studio’s Closure

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Mark Darrah, who worked as an executive producer at BioWare from 1997 - 2021, shared his thoughts on the studio’s recent closure by EA and what he thinks might happen to its iconic IPs.
Former BioWare Executive Producer Mark Darrah Says EA Might Be 'More Likely' to Sell IPs Like Mass Effect and Dragon Age After Studio’s Closure
Mark Darrah, who worked as an Executive Producer at BioWare from 1997–2021, shared his thoughts on the studio’s recent closure by EA and what he thinks might happen to its iconic IPs.
EA announced a major restructuring in a lengthy statement on October 21. Amid some exciting developments for Sims, Fight Night, and Star Wars fans came the devastating news that BioWare — the studio responsible for beloved series like Mass Effect and Dragon Age — was being shut down .
“As we focus on these larger opportunities, we've had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect . We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly,” EA’s statement said.
This news hit the gaming world hard , with fans taking to social media to mourn the developer and send fired staff their well-wishes. But one burning question has risen above the sadness: What does this mean for the future of BioWare’s IPs?
Some fans have urged EA to sell them off to other companies, with CD Projekt Red being a big favorite due to the two studios’ close relationship over the years. And while nothing is certain, Darrah shared some insight as to what’s possible for BioWare’s creations in the wake of this devastating development — and it’s cautiously optimistic.
“Remember BioWare is 100% owned by EA,” he said in a YouTube video . “EA owns all the IPs. They own Dragon Age, they own Mass Effect, they own Jade Empire. That doesn’t change the situation, really, at all. …Now, there’s nobody working on a [BioWare] game, or games, within the EA organization, and chances are there never will be, which might make them more likely to sell off those IPs. But it might also make them more likely to just try to forget that they ever existed and bury them in the vault.
“I think we still are gonna have to wait a little bit before we see if EA has any interest in selling off some of its dormant IPs. Right now, they seem to be in cost control mode. They might start into a revenue-generation mode where selling IPs might be more desirable.”
“I think we still are gonna have to wait a little bit."
